appName.description: 扩展显示名（中性名：本扩展支持多种目标语言，不再自称「汉化」）

appDesc.message: Localize the GitHub interface with a built-in dictionary, entirely on your device. No network requests, no data collection.

hintPrivacy.message: Translation happens entirely on your device: no network requests, no data collection. Switching takes effect immediately (the page reloads).

devHint.message: Collects untranslated text on GitHub pages and keeps it on this device only. Off by default: nothing is collected before you turn it on.

devWarn.message: The export may contain page text such as file and repository names — review it before pasting. No network requests are made at any point.

footer.message: The dictionary keeps growing. Reports of missed or wrong translations are welcome in the repository.
